scripts.postinstall: rm -rf apps/web/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules && if [ -f packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json ]; then mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json); fi
scripts.dev: rm -rf apps/web/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules && mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) && (cd apps/web && next dev --port 3000 --hostname 0.0.0.0)
scripts.build: if [ "$WORKERS_CI" = "1" ] || [ "$CF_PAGES" = "1" ]; then echo 'Cloudflare Worker CI detected: skipping Next.js build'; exit 0; fi && rm -rf .next apps/web/.next apps/web/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules && mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) && (cd apps/web && NODE_ENV=production next build) && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
